system.description:
See also: Force Powers

You call upon The Force to overload an enemy's senses, potentially Stunning them.

Time: Standard Action

Targets: One creature within 6 squares, or within line of sight.

Make a Use the Force check. Compare the result to the target's Fortitude Defense. If the check result equals or exceeds the target's Fortitude Defense, the target moves -1 step along the Condition Track. For every 5 points by which you exceed the target's Fortitude Defense, the target moves an additional -1 step along the Condition Track. Targets larger than Medium add a size modifier to Fortitude Defense against this Force Power: Colossal +50, Gargantuan +20, Huge +10, Large +5.

Special: When you use this Force Power, you can spend a Force Point to move the target an additional -1 step along the Condition Track.
